scope: Independent rereview of all twelve repaired coordinates, their full cases, replacement evidence, same-entry collateral, actors, prose, identity, recension handling, hashes, and gates.

deployment.ruling: A112 occurrences 3 and 6 are source recensions of one Shimen Huiche deployment; retain both but count one deployment class.

confirmedRepairs: A112: repaired Shimen Huiche exact actors are correct.
A113: weak unidentified verse was replaced by an attributable Dahui direct question-and-answer witness.
A114: Jingshan Xiu identity was corrected and Zhe'an Fan supplies an additional unique witness.
A115: prose no longer asserts an unsupported acoustic/response sense menu.
A117: three quoted Zhaozhou coordinates were corrected.
A119: Changqing Huileng is correctly represented as the quoted-original actor with Xuedou in context.
A120: duplicate Tianyin evidence was removed and replaced by Baiyu's flower-sermon/Kasyapa witness.

residuals.finding: The full case is Tuigeng Ning raising Xianglin's old case. Xianglin is the exact headword utterer, but the occurrence is still marked direct-turn and omits Tuigeng Ning.
residuals.requiredAction: Set voiceLayer to quoted-original and record Tuigeng Ning as the later raiser/commentator context actor.

residuals.finding: Shimen Huiche is correctly identified as the exact old-case actor, but Xingyue is falsely asserted as later raiser/commentator. The XML names Xingyue only in the collector byline (行悅集); the target year-end verse paragraph itself does not identify its master.
residuals.requiredAction: Remove the invented Xingyue context attribution unless the outer author can be independently resolved. Retain Shimen and retain the recension as one member of a single deployment class.

residuals.finding: The repair invents a person named 'Falin Yin, the commentary author' from 法林音. In 宗鑑法林 this is a recurring editorial/commentary label, not a personal master identity; the TEI header names 集雲堂 as compiler.
residuals.requiredAction: Represent this as an editorial/compilation voice or other identified non-master branch. Do not create a master identity or link for 法林音.

residuals.finding: The full case has Chushi Fanqi raise Zhaozhou's quoted saying (趙州道...). Zhaozhou Congshen, not Chushi, utters the headword. This untouched same-entry defect means the original changed-only review was incomplete.
residuals.requiredAction: Set MasterName to Zhaozhou Congshen, voiceLayer to quoted-original, and retain Chushi Fanqi as later-raiser/commentator context.

residuals.finding: After replacing one Tianyin occurrence with Baiyu's flower-sermon/Kasyapa witness, the Explanation and draft Zen-bend/evidence prose still say 'both Tianyin records'.
residuals.requiredAction: Change the public and draft prose to singular Tianyin and explicitly account for the Baiyu/Kasyapa deployment.
